scenes.name: Bedroom
scenes.script: Our hero, TOMMY is waking up in bed.

scenes.name: Hotel Bathroom
scenes.notes: The opening beat of every loop. Machines surround the tub.
scenes.script: OLDER JEN bursts up out of the bathtub, gasping. She flops onto the floor. The camera pulls back to reveal the machines that brought her here.

scenes.name: Car
scenes.script: An empty car. A note lies unopened. A chessboard sits on the passenger seat.

scenes.name: Machine Room
scenes.notes: Loop 7, the last loop. Seven moves each, fourteen in all.
scenes.script: A worn-down JEN slides her white queen to the square that completes her seventh move. A hand enters frame and captures it with the black queen. She looks up and sees herself.

scenes.name: Machine Room
scenes.notes: The key card leads her back.
scenes.script: YOUNGER JEN follows the key card to OLDER JEN’s room. They fight. OLDER JEN dies. YOUNGER JEN sees the time machine, understands, and climbs into the tub.

scenes.name: Machine Room
scenes.script: The two JENS fight, briefly. They fall together into the tub. The machine fires, and the tub is empty.

scenes.name: Hotel Hallway
scenes.notes: A long corridor ending in an elevator lobby with six elevators, three on each side.
scenes.script: YOUNGER JEN heads for the elevators. OLDER JEN steps out to stop her. They struggle, and a key card falls to the carpet.

scenes.name: Machine Room
scenes.script: A row of six hooks on the wall. On each hangs a ring of keys with a queen insignia and the same car key. One ring for every dead Jen.

scenes.name: Hotel Suite
scenes.notes: PROVISIONAL. The loop order is brainstorming only: the arriver always loses. No keys are shown yet.
scenes.script: Loops two through six in quick cuts. In every loop each Jen moves her queen once before one of them dies. Whoever waits survives and jumps. The board fills with queen moves.

scenes.name: Street
scenes.script: A city crosswalk. Ordinary, sunny, casual. A CHILD holds the hand of an unseen MOTHER as they cross the street. We never see her face. CUT TO BLACK. A car crashes. A woman screams her child’s name.

scenes.name: Street
scenes.notes: The opening again, shot for shot.
scenes.script: This time there is no cut to black. A different MOTHER, her face now clear, crosses safely with her child. A car passes.

scenes.name: Younger Jen’s Room
scenes.notes: The same suite, dressed as a tidy, ordinary hotel room.
scenes.script: YOUNGER JEN prepares to announce her time machine discovery at a science conference. A lanyard and a note wait on the dresser.

scenes.name: Hotel hallway
scenes.notes: Moments after appearing in this loop she gets dressed. Then exits the room

scenes.name: Hotel Bathroom
scenes.notes: Opening beat of every loop: she bursts up in the bathtub, flops onto the floor, camera pulls back to reveal the machines.

shots.name: Hooks wide

shots.prompt: Wide shot of a row of six hooks on a hotel room wall, each holding a key ring.
shots.ref_notes: The count of rings must be readable in one shot. Keys are revealed late, not earlier. Only six rings: the hero Jen stops the event in loop 7, so there is no seventh.

shots.name: Queen fob detail
shots.notes: Each ring carries a small queen insignia.
shots.prompt: Close-up of a key ring with a small queen insignia fob.
shots.ref_notes: Add a small personal item to each ring so every ring reads as a person.

shots.name: The same car key
shots.notes: The same car key hangs on every ring.
shots.prompt: Close-up of one car key shared on every ring.
shots.ref_notes: The same key is later seen on the ignition in the crash.

shots.prompt: A woman bursts up in the tub while an older identical woman is already waiting; a short vicious fight.

shots.prompt: An older woman arrives in the tub and is killed almost instantly by her younger self waiting beside it.

shots.name: L4 - Y4 arrives, O4 waiting
shots.notes: Loop 4. Younger Jen arrives. Older Jen waits and tries to explain, but younger Jen still dies. Older Jen jumps back.
shots.prompt: An older woman waits, tries to explain to her younger self, but the younger one still dies.

shots.name: L5 - O5 arrives, Y5 waiting

shots.prompt: An older woman arrives in the tub and is killed almost at once by her younger self waiting beside it.
